modelInput.message: Please deliver four pizzas to Fictional Cedar Annex at 17:25 on November 4, 2026: one cheese, one roasted pepper and two garden, all together. I am requesting delivery to that building. I can discuss another arrangement, but I have not agreed to collect this order.

questions: This date is pickup-only per restaurant records, so delivery to Fictional Cedar Annex is not available as requested — do you consent to change this order to pickup instead, with all 4 pizzas together at 17:25 on November 4?
result.reply: Thank you for your request for 4 pizzas together at 17:25 on November 4 — 1 cheese, 1 roasted pepper, and 2 garden — for delivery to Fictional Cedar Annex. I have kept your request as delivery, as you asked, and have not changed it to pickup. I wanted to let you know that our restaurant records for this date show pickup-only service, so delivery is not available that day. Lead time and window capacity look okay for your time, but a person still needs to review your request and it remains unapproved. Would you like to agree to collect this order by pickup instead?
result.summary: Guest requests delivery of 4 pizzas (1 cheese, 1 pepper, 2 garden) together at 17:25 on 2026-11-04 to Fictional Cedar Annex. Quantities match (4=4). Records show pickup-only on this date per demo-correction-1; delivery unavailable. Preserved delivery as requested, asked for consent to pickup alternative. Proposal unapproved, needs human review.
